description: This file declares utility functions related to sparse image processing, specifically for forcing raw image handling and checking if an image is sparse. It belongs to the 'cuttlefish' namespace and includes dependencies such as string and a custom Result class.

methods.name: ForceRawImage
methods.description: Function to process or modify an image at the specified path to be a raw image.

methods.name: IsSparseImage
methods.description: Function to determine whether the image at the specified path is a sparse image.
